scenes.effective_query: A heavy door swings slowly open into a bright empty hallway.
scenes.original_query: A heavy door swings slowly open into a bright empty hallway.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the received story of the trip
scenes.text: Everyone describes it as a door. Something opening. Something arriving from outside you.

scenes.effective_query: A hand turns a physical dimmer dial downward and the room darkens evenly.
scenes.original_query: A hand turns a physical dimmer dial downward and the room darkens evenly.
scenes.text: The leading model says the opposite. Nothing arrives. Something gets turned down.

scenes.effective_query: A camera lens racks focus across an ordinary room until every detail resolves.
scenes.original_query: A camera lens racks focus across an ordinary room until every detail resolves.
scenes.text: Right now your brain is not receiving this room. It is predicting it.

scenes.effective_query: A wireframe outline of a chair fills in with color and texture until it looks real.
scenes.original_query: A wireframe outline of a chair fills in with color and texture until it looks real.
scenes.text: Prediction is cheaper than perception. So your brain guesses, then checks the guess against the signal.

scenes.effective_query: A completely still room held in a locked camera frame while dust drifts in the light.
scenes.original_query: A completely still room held in a locked camera frame while dust drifts in the light.
scenes.text: And it trusts its own guesses enormously. It has to. That trust is what holds the room still.

scenes.effective_query: A scientific paper page turns under a desk lamp and one passage is underlined in pencil.
scenes.original_query: A scientific paper page turns under a desk lamp and one passage is underlined in pencil.
scenes.text: Carhart-Harris and Friston named this REBUS. Psychedelics, they propose, relax that trust.

scenes.effective_query: Bubbles rise steadily upward through a tall glass of dark liquid toward the surface.
scenes.original_query: Bubbles rise steadily upward through a tall glass of dark liquid toward the surface.
scenes.text: The high-level predictions stop outvoting the raw signal coming up from below.

scenes.effective_query: A hand writes the word FILTER on paper and then draws quotation marks around it.
scenes.original_query: A hand writes the word FILTER on paper and then draws quotation marks around it.
scenes.text: Call it a filter easing off. But hear the word filter as metaphor, not anatomy.
There is no valve in your head. There is only confidence, weighted, and then loosened.

scenes.effective_query: Daylight floods into a dim room as heavy curtains are drawn fully open.
scenes.original_query: Daylight floods into a dim room as heavy curtains are drawn fully open.
scenes.text: What floods in was never far away. It was being subtracted, quietly, every second of your life.

scenes.effective_query: A person stands perfectly still on a moving walkway as the corridor slides past them.
scenes.original_query: A person stands perfectly still on a moving walkway as the corridor slides past them.
scenes.text: Which reframes the whole experience. You did not travel anywhere. Subtraction paused.

scenes.effective_query: Several different hands reach in one after another and adjust the same control knob.
scenes.original_query: Several different hands reach in one after another and adjust the same control knob.
scenes.text: And if it is a dial rather than a door, chemistry is not the only hand on it.

scenes.effective_query: A small figure stands at the base of an enormous cliff face and looks upward.
scenes.original_query: A small figure stands at the base of an enormous cliff face and looks upward.
scenes.text: Grief moves it. Standing in front of something enormous moves it.

scenes.effective_query: A person sits cross-legged on a bare floor, completely still, as afternoon light shifts across them.
scenes.original_query: A person sits cross-legged on a bare floor, completely still, as afternoon light shifts across them.
scenes.text: Forty uncomfortable minutes of sitting still moves it.

scenes.effective_query: A still pond surface is broken suddenly by a single unexpected falling drop.
scenes.original_query: A still pond surface is broken suddenly by a single unexpected falling drop.
scenes.text: Being genuinely surprised, which is rarer than you think, moves it.

scenes.effective_query: An oscilloscope screen fills with dense irregular waveform activity in a dark lab.
scenes.original_query: An oscilloscope screen fills with dense irregular waveform activity in a dark lab.
scenes.text: Here is the honest part. We can measure a noisier brain under these compounds.

scenes.effective_query: Two researchers at a whiteboard disagree, erasing and rewriting the same diagram.
scenes.original_query: Two researchers at a whiteboard disagree, erasing and rewriting the same diagram.
scenes.text: Whether noisier means truer is still an open fight among the people who study it.

scenes.effective_query: Two nearly identical printed charts are laid side by side and carefully compared.
scenes.original_query: Two nearly identical printed charts are laid side by side and carefully compared.
scenes.text: Signal diversity is not the same as seeing more clearly. Hold that loosely.

scenes.effective_query: A slow push through a doorway into an ordinary lived-in living room at dusk.
scenes.original_query: A slow push through a doorway into an ordinary lived-in living room at dusk.
scenes.text: So come back to the room you are actually sitting in.

scenes.effective_query: Close details of an ordinary room: a mug, a cable, light moving slowly on a plain wall.
scenes.original_query: Close details of an ordinary room: a mug, a cable, light moving slowly on a plain wall.
scenes.semantic_anchor: return to the body and room
scenes.text: Your hands. The light on the wall. The sound underneath the sound.

scenes.effective_query: A dimmer dial is raised again and warm light returns evenly across a plain wall.
scenes.original_query: A dimmer dial is raised again and warm light returns evenly across a plain wall.
scenes.text: All of it already ran the same filter, at a setting you never chose.
This ordinary version is not the lesser one. It is the rendered one.
You have been inside the machine the entire time, calling it the world.

scenes.effective_query: A person looks at their own open hand in daylight as if seeing it for the first time.
scenes.original_query: A person looks at their own open hand in daylight as if seeing it for the first time.
scenes.text: So when did the world last come off like a skin, and what were you doing right before?
